maintenance_led.reason: Mainly sells new SBC, IP routing and optical networking products and software to carriers; services and support are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private telecom carriers (Verizon, Bharti Airtel, BT) and enterprises; defense and BEAD-funded work are minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own products; Sonus-GENBAND (2017) and ECI (2020) were occasional large mergers, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: SBCs, voice core and optical transport are embedded in carrier networks; switching means re-qualification, migration and outage risk.
